name: gated-development-orchestration
description: Coordinate human-verifiable checkpoint development through role-scoped rounds, human actor takeover, bounded correction, lightweight targeted development checks, evidence economy, concise lifecycle records, and independent review.

interface.longDescription: GDO 4.4 preserves the v3 lifecycle, Human TAKEOVER, correction completeness, Evidence economy, and delta-oriented lifecycle records while adding lightweight targeted development checks inside active Implementation rounds so native/runtime feedback does not require a full Evidence round for every small correction.
defaultPrompt: Load the GDO workflow core and only the active role skill.
Perform the authorized GDO round using current GitHub authority and current actor authority.
During Implementation, use targeted development checks only for one bounded candidate-specific observation; treat results as development feedback, never Evidence.
Keep lifecycle comments delta-oriented: compress duplicated authority/raw detail, never provenance, correction boundary, proof disposition, or machine routing fields.
Preserve v3 lifecycle markers, bounded correction scope, retained valid proof, actor-takeover semantics, and sole Independent Review PASS authority.
